name: oppi-server
description: Self-hosted server for the Oppi mobile coding agent
author: Chaos Donkey

scripts.build: bash -c 'npm run clean && npm run compile && node scripts/copy-oppi-docs.mjs && chmod +x dist/src/cli.js'
scripts.prepare: bash -c 'npm run clean && npm run compile && node scripts/copy-oppi-docs.mjs && chmod +x dist/src/cli.js'
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run check:pi-release-versions && npm run check:pack-contents
scripts.bench: npm run bench:correctness && npm run bench:perf:gate
scripts.bench:hotpath:gate: npm run bench:correctness && tsx bench/run-gate.ts --suite hotpath --runs 3 --metric-set avg --max-regression-pct 15 --min-baseline-us 0.2 --max-absolute-regression-us 0.05
scripts.test:e2e:paired-compat: E2E_NATIVE=1 npm run test:e2e:clean && E2E_NATIVE=1 vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/paired-session
scripts.test:e2e:auth-connection: E2E_NATIVE=1 npm run test:e2e:clean && E2E_NATIVE=1 vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/pairing-flow e2e/paired-session
scripts.test:e2e:quick: npm run test:e2e:clean && E2E_STRICT=1 vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/quick-session-send
scripts.check: prettier --version >/dev/null && bash -c 'pids=(); npm run typecheck & pids+=($!); npm run protocol:fixtures:typecheck & pids+=($!); eslint src/ extensions/ bench/ & pids+=($!); knip & pids+=($!); prettier --check --ignore-unknown src/ extensions/ bench/ & pids+=($!); bun scripts/check-architecture-boundaries.ts & pids+=($!); bun scripts/check-compose-mounts.ts & pids+=($!); rc=0; for p in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$p" || rc=1; done; exit $rc'
scripts.check:server: prettier --version >/dev/null && bash -c 'pids=(); npm run typecheck & pids+=($!); npm run protocol:fixtures:typecheck & pids+=($!); eslint src/ extensions/ bench/ & pids+=($!); knip & pids+=($!); prettier --check --ignore-unknown src/ extensions/ bench/ & pids+=($!); bun scripts/check-architecture-boundaries.ts --scope server & pids+=($!); bun scripts/check-compose-mounts.ts & pids+=($!); rc=0; for p in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$p" || rc=1; done; exit $rc'
